ogw.text: Halimar Basin is drained after Sea Gate falls, and in Oath of the Gatewatch it becomes the site where the Eldrazi titans are headed and where the Sea Gate survivors regroup, joined by Kiora.
The Gatewatch chooses a direct attack: Nissa shapes the leylines into a binding glyph while Gideon lures the titans into the ambush, and the binding locks so that the titans begin to tear apart.
Kiora betrays the group by lifting the Halimar Sea to hurl at Nissa, but Jace deflects it onto the Eldrazi spawn.
Chandra then attacks as Nissa channels leyline mana to her, igniting the leylines and destroying both titans, and Kiora walks away from the battlefield.
